offers_products.reason: Develops, manufactures and distributes oral controlled-release generic drug products under the Elite Laboratories label.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes mainly from drug product sales. Development and licensing work is a minor side line.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells generics nationally through wholesalers and distributors. Patients don't choose or buy directly from Elite.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are drug wholesalers, distributors and licensees such as TAGI Pharma that resell the generics.

recurring_revenue.reason: Generic drugs are reordered repeatedly by the same distributors and partners, so revenue keeps recurring.

cyclical_demand.reason: Generic prescription drugs, including pain medicines, are needed medical care and aren't easily postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Generic oral drugs are small, frequent, repeat purchases by wholesalers and distributors.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured generic drug products, not the time of staff.

large_customers.reason: Generic drugs are sold mainly to large wholesalers, distributors and licensee partners such as TAGI Pharma.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates its own cGMP, DEA-registered manufacturing facility in Northvale, NJ; pharmaceutical manufacturing needs ongoing plant investment.

notes: Some revenue may come from contract manufacturing and licensing. Customer mix is based on general knowledge of the generic drug industry.
